question: When do AIMS applications open and close each year?
answer: Admission applications at all AIMS centres open on 1 December each year and close on 23 March. Apply as early as possible to improve your chances.
evidence: Les demandes d'admission dans tous les centres AIMS sont ouvertes le 1er décembre de chaque année.
Les candidatures se clôtureront le 23 mars de chaque année.

question: wat do i need to fill out an aims application
answer: You'll need to complete an online application form (including questions about yourself), provide contact details for two referees (whom AIMS will contact), and submit copies of your transcripts.
evidence: Les candidats devront remplir un formulaire de candidature en ligne (qui comprend des réponses aux questions les concernant), les coordonnées de deux arbitres (que l'AIMS contactera) et fournir des copies de leurs relevés de notes.

question: do i need to take the gre or toefl to apply to aims
answer: No, you don't need to take a GRE or TOEFL test.
evidence: Dois-je passer un test GRE ou TOEFL?

question: Do I need to translate my transcripts if they're not in English or French?
answer: It's not strictly necessary, but AIMS recommends doing so.
evidence: Pas nécessaire, mais nous vous recommandons de le faire.

question: what qualifies me to apply to aims
answer: You must hold, or expect to complete before the AIMS course start date, a 4-year university degree in mathematics or any scientific/technical subject with a significant mathematics component.
evidence: Les candidats doivent détenir, ou prévoir terminer avant la date de début du cours AIMS, un diplôme universitaire de 4 ans en mathématiques ou toute matière scientifique ou technique comportant une composante mathématique importante.

question: how long after applying will i know if i got in?
answer: Accepted candidates are informed in early April. All candidates will know their result by 31 May at the latest.
evidence: Tous les candidats connaîtront le résultat de leur candidature au plus tard le 31 mai de chaque année.

question: Do I have to pay tuition, travel, or boarding costs to study at AIMS?
answer: No — thanks to generous donor support, all African students receive full scholarships covering travel, boarding, and a small allowance. There's no tuition fee at AIMS.
evidence: tous les étudiants africains reçoivent des bourses complètes qui prévoient pleinement les voyages, la pension et une petite allocation. Il n'y a pas de frais de scolarité à l'AIMS.

question: What qualification do I get after completing the AIMS program?
answer: AIMS offers an intensive one-year postgraduate course leading to a Master's degree in Mathematical Sciences; the exact qualification and awarding institution depends on which AIMS centre you attend.
evidence: AIMS propose un cours intensif de troisième cycle d'un an menant à une maîtrise en sciences mathématiques.

question: can i change my application details after submitting, and what if my email changes?
answer: No, you can't modify your application details after submission. But if your email address changes, let AIMS know at applications2014@nexteinstein.org to avoid delays in evaluating your application.
evidence: Non. Cependant, si votre adresse e-mail change, veuillez nous en informer par e-mail: applications2014@nexteinstein.org.
